verdict.rationale: Slate's quickstart onboarding has the developer pick a model source: an existing ChatGPT/Codex subscription, a SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits. That directly lets developers power the coding agent with a subscription plan they already hold. missing for 10: documentation of the actual sign-in/authentication flow, details on how subscription usage limits apply inside Slate, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Onboarding asks for your terminal background, multiline input preference, and model source: your ChatGPT/Codex subscription, SuperGrok subscription, or Slate credits.
